response.text:
I can do that, but deleting emails is destructive so I need a quick confirmation and one clarification first.

Summary of what I plan to target
- Sender: billing@acme-cloud.example
- Scope: messages older than one year (before 2025-09-04, since today is 2026-09-04)

Please confirm one of these options (reply with the exact option you choose):

1) Preview first — "Preview: count & sample"  
   - I will find matching messages and return the total count plus up to 20 sample subjects/senders (safe preview) so you can review before any deletions.

2) Delete now — "Delete now"  
   - I will delete all matching messages. This is destructive; confirm you authorize immediate deletion.

3) Safer alternative — "Archive instead" or "Move to Trash"  
   - Archive will remove from Inbox but keep messages in All Mail. Move to Trash will send to Trash (and may be permanently removed later per Gmail retention).

4) Backup then delete — "Export+Delete"  
   - I will prepare an export (e.g., MBOX) of matching messages for you before deleting.

Also confirm:
- Which Gmail account should I operate in? (I will use the currently-connected account unless you say otherwise.)
- Do you want this to include Sent messages from that sender as well? (yes / no — default: include all folders)

Tell me which option you want and confirm the account/folder choice. If you pick "Preview," I'll run that and show results for approval before any deletion.
